payout_quote: To earn bonuses, the Eligible Invest Recipient must: (1) open a new SoFi Invest Self-Directed Account using the Eligible Invest Referrer's unique referral link; (2) fund the new account with a minimum deposit of $25.00; and (3) complete both steps within 90 calendar days... SoFi Securities LLC will: (a) credit the Eligible Invest Referrer's account with a $75 cash bonus if the Eligible Invest Referrer satisfies the eligibility requirements... (b) otherwise, credit the Eligible Invest Referrer's account with a $50 cash bonus; and (c) credit the new account of the Eligible Invest Recipient with a $25 stock bonus. (Official SoFi Invest Referral terms, crawled 2026-09-23)
timing: Credited to the referrer's Invest account after the recipient opens and funds within the 90-day window
eligibility: SoFi member with an Invest account; recipient must be new to SoFi Invest (no current or prior SoFi Invest account), open a Self-Directed account via your unique link, and fund $25+ within 90 days
steps: Open your own SoFi Invest account
Share your unique Invest referral link with someone interested in investing
Recipient opens a new SoFi Invest Self-Directed account via your link
Recipient funds at least $25 within 90 days
You receive $50 cash (or $75 if you meet the higher eligibility tier); they get a $25 stock bonus
catches: The friend must actually FUND $25 within 90 days - signups alone earn nothing
Only Self-Directed accounts qualify - Automated Invest and IRA referrals earn nothing
You can't earn on anyone who already had a SoFi Invest account
$10,000 annual cap across ALL SoFi referral programs per calendar year
SoFi won't disclose recipient account info to you - you must trust the friend completed funding
You must have express consent to send promotional messages about SoFi products
biggest_catch: Only Self-Directed (not IRA, not automated) accounts count, the friend must fund $25 within 90 days, and there's a $10,000/year cap across all SoFi referral programs.

maximize: Share with people already curious about investing - the $25 funding minimum is trivial for anyone serious, which makes this one of the easiest referrals to actually complete. Follow up around day 60 with anyone who signed up but hasn't funded; most lost referrals die in the funding step, not the signup step. Don't waste links on existing SoFi users - check first, since prior SoFi Invest accounts disqualify the bonus entirely.
